name: Cyber Muyu (赛博木鱼)
author: chivopic
description: A desktop Zen sanctuary for the Omarchy bar: tap the electronic wooden fish to relieve stress, accumulate cyber merits (+1 功德 / Bug -1), level up your coder karma, and find inner peace during long compilations.

barWidget.description: Electronic wooden fish & merit counter for anti-stress mindfulness

schema.label: Show merit count on bar
schema.description: Display today's merit count next to the lotus icon on the bar.

schema.label: Default sound effect
schema.description: Sound to play when striking the wooden fish (muyu, bowl, bubble, click).

schema.label: Default mantra text
schema.description: Floating text displayed on strike (e.g. 功德 +1, Bug -1, 头发 +1).

schema.label: Auto-knock speed (BPM)
schema.description: Beats per minute when auto-knocking is enabled.

schema.label: Daily merit goal
schema.description: Number of merits to reach your daily mindfulness milestone (e.g. 108).
